items.Sentence: The Producer/Discharger proposes the following sequence of unit processes at the sub-regional plant: • influent pump station and pumps
The Producer/Discharger proposes the following sequence of unit processes at the sub-regional plant: • fine screens
The Producer/Discharger proposes the following sequence of unit processes at the sub-regional plant: • grit removal
MBR technology combines aerobic treatment, anoxic treatment, and membrane filtration resulting in a tertiary treated, nitrogen reduced effluent.
The Producer/Discharger proposes the following sequence of unit processes at the sub-regional plant: • ultraviolet disinfection
Collected solids from the fine screens and grit removal will be transported offsite to an authorized solid waste disposal facility.

Biosolids from the aerobic treatment, anoxic treatment, and membrane bioreactor filtration system are discharged to the community sewage collection system where they will be treated at the regional plant.
